draft.subject: The Perception and Edge AI robotics role
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas, and I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I came across the Robotics Software Engineer role for perception and edge AI that MBN is running. Since you founded the firm and focus on building AI teams, I wanted to reach out to you directly.

That role sits right in the middle of what I do. I build computer vision and object tracking software and deploy it onto NVIDIA Jetson and embedded controllers, tuned to run fast enough for a robot to act in real time. My capstone took a vision guided robotic arm from perception through to the physical grasp, and I have also built perception stacks for autonomous driving in simulation and a tracking turret running on Jetson.

I know the posting asks for commercial robotics experience and I am early in my career, but the perception and edge work lines up closely with it. Let me know whether you or the right person at MBN would be open to a short conversation.
